reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in our DM: his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Corvid rollout is Mondays at 13:45.

That time comes from the gbrain record of what he told me in this DM on Oct 14. He said it applies from then on. The DM history the world tools show me only has today's question, not the Oct 14 message, so the brain is the only source for the time. There's no event for it on his calendar, and I offered to set up an invite if he wants one.

I only used his own DM with me, so nothing private was shared anywhere else.
